name: bookmark-intelligence-hub-rework-and-ideation
title: Bookmark Intelligence Hub: Rework and Ideation Integration
description: Major rework of scenarios/bookmark-intelligence-hub plus integration with the vision-walk ideation pipeline. Originally designed around automated multi-platform scraping (Huginn agents + browserless fallback for X/Reddit/TikTok); operator surfaced at vision walk #4 (2026-04-27) that this orientation is structurally wrong for the v0 actually needed: manual paste-first link entry with operator-supplied notes, plus a Vrooli-use classification taxonomy alongside the existing content-shape categories, plus an ideation-extraction agent that surfaces idea candidates into the morning vision walk. Drop Huginn entirely; future automated extraction routes through Browser Automation Studio per the wrap-not-use principle. See orchestration-summary.md for the full context, reasoning, and integration plan.
